title: HSK 3.8 · 演员, 导演, 危险, 文化, 成长
focus: 老板 · 祝 · 危险 · 乱 · 救 · 图 · 媒体 · 痛 · 变化 · 痛苦 · 文件 · 效果 · 有效 · 成员 · 保险 · 领导 · 演出 · 保 · 演 · 文化 · 具体 · 演员 · 确保 · 队员 · 风险 · 具有 · 板 · 发表 · 员工 · 员 · 成熟 · 文章 · 发出 · 化 · 领 · 导演 · 成长 · 指导 · 工具 · 形成
body:
People and performance: 员 (member) ends five words, 演 (perform) appears in four, and 险 (danger) and 保 (protect) pair up in 保险. 成 (become) and 文 (writing) also keep coming back.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 员 | yuán | member, person in a role | 成员, 演员, 队员, 员工, 员 |
| 演 | yǎn | perform | 演出, 演, 演员, 导演 |
| 成 | chéng | become, complete | 成员, 成熟, 成长, 形成 |
| 保 | bǎo | protect, ensure | 保险, 保, 确保 |
| 险 | xiǎn | danger (阝 hill) | 危险, 保险, 风险 |
| 导 | dǎo | guide | 领导, 导演, 指导 |
| 文 | wén | writing | 文件, 文化, 文章 |
| 具 | jù | tool; have | 具体, 具有, 工具 |

## Watch out

- 祝 has 礻 (altar, one dot); 衤 (clothing) has two.
- 长 is zhǎng (grow) in 成长 but cháng (long) elsewhere.
- 熟 is shú in writing, often shóu in speech.

cards.Example: 老板，买单！ lǎobǎn, mǎidān: boss, the bill please!
cards.Notes: 老 old, respected + 板 board (木 wood + 反 fǎn for the sound) = boss, shop owner.

cards.Example: 祝你生日快乐！ zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè: happy birthday!
cards.Notes: 礻 altar + 兄 (a person with an open mouth) = praying at an altar → to wish. 礻 one dot, 衤 two.

cards.Example: 这里很危险。 zhèlǐ hěn wēixiǎn: it's dangerous here
cards.Notes: 危 perilous (a person at a cliff edge) + 险 dangerous (阝 hill + 佥 for the sound) = danger.

cards.Example: 房间太乱了。 fángjiān tài luàn le: the room is a mess
cards.Notes: 舌 + 乚. Before verbs: carelessly, randomly (别乱说 don't talk nonsense).

cards.Example: 救命！ jiùmìng: help!
cards.Notes: 求 qiú (seek; sound) + 攵 action = rescue. 救命 = save a life → help!

cards.Example: 你看这张图。 nǐ kàn zhè zhāng tú: look at this picture
cards.Notes: 囗 frame + 冬 inside = a drawing inside a border → picture, map. 地图 map.

cards.Example: 媒体都报道了。 méitǐ dōu bàodào le: all the media reported it
cards.Notes: 媒 go-between (女 + 某 mǒu for the sound) + 体 body = go-between body → media.

cards.Example: 我头痛。 wǒ tóu tòng: I have a headache
cards.Notes: 疒 illness + 甬 yǒng for the sound = pain. 疒 marks illness: 病, 疼.

cards.Example: 这里变化很大。 zhèlǐ biànhuà hěn dà: this place has changed a lot
cards.Notes: 变 change + 化 transform = change.

cards.Example: 他很痛苦。 tā hěn tòngkǔ: he's suffering a lot
cards.Notes: 痛 pain + 苦 bitter = painful suffering.

cards.Example: 请把文件发给我。 qǐng bǎ wénjiàn fā gěi wǒ: please send me the file
cards.Notes: 文 writing + 件 item = a written item → document, file.

cards.Example: 效果很好。 xiàoguǒ hěn hǎo: it works well
cards.Notes: 效 effect (交 jiāo for the sound + 攵) + 果 fruit, result = the fruit of effort → effect.

cards.Example: 这个药很有效。 zhège yào hěn yǒuxiào: this medicine works well
cards.Notes: 有 have + 效 effect = effective; also valid (有效期 expiry date).

cards.Example: 我们家有五个成员。 wǒmen jiā yǒu wǔ ge chéngyuán: our family has five members
cards.Notes: 成 make up + 员 member = members making up a group.

cards.Example: 你买保险了吗？ nǐ mǎi bǎoxiǎn le ma: did you buy insurance?
cards.Notes: 保 protect + 险 danger = protect against danger → insurance; also "safe, sure".

cards.Example: 他是我的领导。 tā shì wǒ de lǐngdǎo: he's my boss
cards.Notes: 领 lead (令 lìng for the sound + 页 head) + 导 guide = lead; also one's superior.

cards.Example: 今晚有演出。 jīn wǎn yǒu yǎnchū: there's a show tonight
cards.Notes: 演 perform + 出 out = put on a show.

cards.Example: 保你满意。 bǎo nǐ mǎnyì: satisfaction guaranteed
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 呆 (originally a child carried on the back) = protect.

cards.Example: 他演得很好。 tā yǎn de hěn hǎo: he acts really well
cards.Notes: 氵 water + 寅 yín for the sound = perform, act. 演员 actor.

cards.Example: 我喜欢中国文化。 wǒ xǐhuan Zhōngguó wénhuà: I like Chinese culture
cards.Notes: 文 writing, refinement + 化 transform = transformed by refinement → culture.

cards.Example: 具体说说。 jùtǐ shuōshuo: be more specific
cards.Notes: 具 tool, have + 体 body, form = having a solid form → concrete, specific.

cards.Example: 她是演员。 tā shì yǎnyuán: she's an actress
cards.Notes: 演 act + 员 person in a role = actor.

cards.Example: 请确保门关好。 qǐng quèbǎo mén guān hǎo: please make sure the door is shut
cards.Notes: 确 firm, sure + 保 guarantee = ensure.

cards.Example: 他是新队员。 tā shì xīn duìyuán: he's a new team member
cards.Notes: 队 team (阝 + 人) + 员 member = team member.

cards.Example: 这样做风险很大。 zhèyàng zuò fēngxiǎn hěn dà: doing it this way is very risky
cards.Notes: 风 wind + 险 danger = risk.

cards.Example: 这具有重要意义。 zhè jùyǒu zhòngyào yìyì: this has great significance
cards.Notes: 具 have, possess + 有 have = possess. Formal, used with abstract nouns.

cards.Example: 黑板上写着字。 hēibǎn shang xiě zhe zì: there's writing on the blackboard
cards.Notes: 木 wood + 反 fǎn for the sound = wooden board. 黑板 blackboard, 老板 boss.

cards.Example: 他发表了一篇文章。 tā fābiǎo le yì piān wénzhāng: he published an article
cards.Notes: 发 send out + 表 show = put out publicly → publish.

cards.Example: 公司有一百个员工。 gōngsī yǒu yìbǎi ge yuángōng: the company has 100 staff
cards.Notes: 员 member + 工 work = worker → employee.

cards.Example: 他是我们班的一员。 tā shì wǒmen bān de yì yuán: he's one of our class
cards.Notes: 口 + 贝. Suffix for people in a role: 服务员, 演员, 队员.

cards.Example: 他很成熟。 tā hěn chéngshú: he's very mature
cards.Notes: 成 become + 熟 ripe, cooked (灬 fire at the bottom) = ripened → mature.

cards.Example: 这篇文章很好。 zhè piān wénzhāng hěn hǎo: this article is good
cards.Notes: 文 writing + 章 chapter (立 + 早) = a written piece → article.

cards.Example: 他发出了声音。 tā fāchū le shēngyīn: he made a sound
cards.Notes: 发 send + 出 out = issue, emit.

cards.Example: 雪化了。 xuě huà le: the snow has melted
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 匕 (a person turned upside down) = turn into → transform. Suffix -化 = -ize.

cards.Example: 我去领快递。 wǒ qù lǐng kuàidì: I'm going to pick up a parcel
cards.Notes: 令 lìng for the sound + 页 head = neck, collar → lead; also collect, receive.

cards.Example: 他是电影导演。 tā shì diànyǐng dǎoyǎn: he's a film director
cards.Notes: 导 guide + 演 perform = guide the acting → director.

cards.Example: 孩子成长得很快。 háizi chéngzhǎng de hěn kuài: kids grow up fast
cards.Notes: 成 become + 长 zhǎng grow = grow up. 长 is cháng "long" elsewhere.

cards.Example: 谢谢您的指导。 xièxie nín de zhǐdǎo: thank you for your guidance
cards.Notes: 指 point + 导 guide = point the way → guide.

cards.Example: 你有工具吗？ nǐ yǒu gōngjù ma: do you have any tools?
cards.Notes: 工 work + 具 implement = tool.

cards.Example: 慢慢形成了习惯。 mànmàn xíngchéng le xíguàn: it slowly became a habit
cards.Notes: 形 shape (彡 strokes) + 成 become = take shape.
